adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` copies legacy `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` entries using raw interpolated SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), which both (a) bypasses `EmbeddableHost`’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths, and (b) does not escape quotes. Since `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses a URL and compares `uri.host` against `lower(host)`, any migrated rows stored as `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (explicitly supported by the old `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` logic/tests removed in this diff) will not match and thus will lose embed permission after upgrade.
